title: SO-1.02 Reconciliation: one work breakdown that accounts for every requirement, contract, pull request and branch
request: Closes G-SO-02 (addendum 1, review row 1: reconciliation cadence not pinned). Source: the Scope One addendum (PR #222, docs/scope-one/ADDENDUM-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DELIVERY-REVIEW.md at head a1757a0) and its review table (issuecomment-6534383323); owner request of 31 Oct 2026 that every aspect be decomposed in the WBS and built into contracts (t531u). The addendum names recommendations that become contracts on acceptance; this contract is the design-record stage, so it asks for the decision record and builds nothing. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository. Depends on contracts: SO-T-A.

tasks.title: Decision record
requirements: Reconcile every Scope One branch and open PR against current `main` before commissioning overlapping work.
Give each canonical requirement one owner, one implementation path, explicit dependencies and acceptance tests.
Mark work as implemented, merged, integrated and verified separately; do not use these terms interchangeably.
Close or supersede duplicate/twin contracts explicitly, preserving links and rationale.
Reconcile the takeover register whenever the baseline changes. Treat counts in old snapshots as historical, not live status.

criteria.statement: The record decides requirement 1: Reconcile every Scope One branch and open PR against current `main` before commissioning overlapping work.
The record decides requirement 2: Give each canonical requirement one owner, one implementation path, explicit dependencies and acceptance tests.
The record decides requirement 3: Mark work as implemented, merged, integrated and verified separately; do not use these terms interchangeably.
The record decides requirement 4: Close or supersede duplicate/twin contracts explicitly, preserving links and rationale.
The record decides requirement 5: Reconcile the takeover register whenever the baseline changes. Treat counts in old snapshots as historical, not live status.
The record names the reconciliation cadence
The decision record passes the leak scan
The documentation links and up-links stay valid

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
